title: 20% off DVD, Blu-Ray & 4K (Excludes Pre-Orders) + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store) @ JB Hi-Fi
body:
Deal: 20% off DVD, Blu-Ray & 4K (Excludes Pre-Orders) + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store) @ JB Hi-Fi

[xxssmmmmxx] There's nothing to apply in cart. The prices have already been reduced by 20%. It literally shows you the ticket price crossed out with the sale price below it.
[HangryCakeStore] 20% is pathetic considering the constant fake inflation on prices of everything!
[TheGman101] It's been a while since I've looked but sooo many are now into the high $30's and $40+ range.
[Munkeyalan] Added 7 items to my cart to check availability. Only 1 item available within 200km.
[stubbietubbie] Nice of JB to push this then advertise a Spend $300 get $30 off deal so soon after lol.
Literally had to reorder what I just bought and submit a cancellation for the other one. (Anime has become ****ing expensive so every discount helps)
If I'd gone to bed and left it as was, I'd be livid tomorrow morning.
[TheGman101] Wow that's a crazy amount to spend in one go what did you get?
[stubbietubbie] Mainly keeping up to date with some series (MHA, DBZ, Gundam, That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime) plus Lycoris Recoil.
Also jumped on the 4K copy of Eyes Wide Shut because I'm a Kubrick simp.
